description:
**Exact small CVRP by complete route generation and set partitioning.** Use a complete nonnegative integer distance matrix, firm homogeneous capacity and at most nine customers. There is no fixed fleet size. Check each nonempty feasible customer subset and find its least-cost depot order by exact fixed-path dynamic programming.

Pass every feasible subset and its least-cost route to set partitioning. Select a disjoint cover of all customers to minimize total distance. Keeping one least-cost order for each subset preserves an optimal solution under these assumptions.

The subset enumeration and disjoint-cover search are exponential. The reference is intended for small instances and supplies an objective oracle under its stated constraints.
